NOTE
**Still not ready — requested commit message fixes haven't been made**

New: One push since the feedback, but the commit messages are unchanged and the PR description still says "Fixes part of: #16094". Missing: the "Fixes a part of" lines still need removing, with "Fixes: #16094" added after the description in the last commit. The screenshots are also unverified against the precise before/after guidelines.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready"; @whilstsomebody said they'd review once the commits are fixed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The commit messages still look unchanged: please remove the "Fixes a part of" lines and put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit, per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages). Please also make sure the screenshots follow the [precise before/after guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
